📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #122 (family total; this monitor's own count folded into the shared entry).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@crm-experience` / `#team-crm`)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor ID in the 5-sibling family) → pull DD metric over a multi-hour window (expect brief dip below floor, not a real gap) → confirm 0 `status:error` logs → check sibling 5xx/latency monitor → if fire is still open after ~1h or a sibling co-fires, escalate.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no live Slack message observed):
  • DD monitor 302057011: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011
  • DD logs (0 hits, status:error window): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%20env%3Aprod%20status%3Aerror&from_ts=1786671000000&to_ts=1786677300000&live=false
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786671000&end=1786677300
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this KB, not elasticsearch
  • This-window concentration: sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber} dipped repeatedly below the 2msg/s/15m floor 01:52-02:10Z then self-recovered by 02:47:31Z; 0 error logs

Note: KB entry's match.channels was scoped to alert-system/swat only; added alert-runtime-monitoring (this monitor's confirmed real DD notify target) so future cycles match directly.

Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Integrations` (`@integrations` / `#team-integrations`)

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #660 in this entry's history (chronic, fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` — spans method-ui frontend + gateway-routed backend, no single ownership.md row covers it
Playbook: light-touch DD logs re-check of the monitor's own 5-min per-account rollup; if no single account reproduces the >40 threshold, mechanism stays unconfirmed but the shared-endpoint shape (syncutil/syncwidget across many accounts) is consistent with prior occurrences.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no live Slack message observed):
  • DD monitor 77419271: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271
  • DD logs (21 hits in the monitor's own 5min rollup window, no single account reached the >40 threshold on re-query): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-ui%20-%2AResizeObserver%2A%20-%2Asegment%2A%20-%2Asignalr%2A%20-%2Amixpanel%2A%20-%2Ahotjar%2A%20-%22Minified%20Redux%20error%22%20status%3Aerror%20%2Axhr%2A&from_ts=1786695071000&to_ts=1786695371000&live=false
  • Kibana: n/a — KB entry doesn't declare evidence_source; treated as datadog_logs per the monitor's own query
  • This-window concentration: api:5, officefurniturecentreglasgow:3, holdit:2, back2internationalltd:2, wholelogreclaimed3:1 — all hitting the shared /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget endpoint across distinct accounts

Note: mechanism unconfirmed on this re-check (same as most prior occurrences) — confidence downgraded to 0.55, disclosed in the investigation doc.
